metadata.purpose: Five guideline-audited clinical reasoning questions requiring an intermediate conclusion that determines the next evidence step.
metadata.question_style_policy: Questions are natural clinical doubts and do not name the source sections.
metadata.section_annotation_policy: Gold annotations use the smallest section set required to support the requested answer. Broad parents and general context are excluded unless they contain indispensable independent evidence.
metadata.evaluation_policy: Report single_section, multi_section, reasoning_multi_hop, and graph_hop_path_verified separately. Graph-conditioned results are diagnostic and must not be presented as an unbiased clinical-query sample.

questions.question: Genetic testing in a patient with cardiomyopathy identifies only a variant of uncertain significance. Can I use that result for predictive testing in first-degree relatives and discharge relatives who test negative, or how should the family be followed?

sections: 6.11. Family screening and follow-up evaluation of relatives

metadata.hop_chain: VUS interpretation -> predictive-testing eligibility -> continued clinical surveillance

questions.question: A patient with non-dilated left ventricular cardiomyopathy develops atrioventricular block and has patchy non-ischaemic late gadolinium enhancement together with mediastinal lymphadenopathy. Which inflammatory aetiology should be suspected, what targeted imaging should follow, and when would endomyocardial biopsy be justified?

metadata.hop_chain: conduction and scar red flags -> cardiac sarcoidosis -> targeted PET -> selective biopsy

questions.question: A child has biatrial enlargement, restrictive ventricular filling, and preserved ventricular size, and is already being considered for transplantation. What cardiomyopathy phenotype does this suggest, and why should pulmonary vascular resistance be measured repeatedly even if the child appears clinically stable?

metadata.hop_chain: haemodynamic phenotype -> restrictive cardiomyopathy -> transplant-relevant PVR surveillance

questions.question: A woman with otherwise unexplained concentric left ventricular hypertrophy also has neuropathic pain, angiokeratomas, proteinuria, and low native T1 on CMR. Which diagnosis should be pursued, how should it be confirmed in a woman, and why does recognizing it early matter for treatment?
questions.expected_format: phenocopy diagnosis, confirmation, and treatment rationale

sections: 7.6.1.2. Diagnosis, clinical work-up, and differential diagnosis

metadata.hop_chain: cardiac and extracardiac red flags -> Anderson-Fabry disease -> sex-aware confirmation -> early disease-specific treatment

questions.question: A pregnant woman with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy has severe left ventricular outflow tract obstruction and reaches labour while taking oral anticoagulation. How should the mode of delivery and immediate post-partum monitoring be planned?

metadata.hop_chain: maternal phenotype and anticoagulation -> delivery choice -> haemodynamic post-partum surveillance
